title: [Financial Reports] Add row and column definition preview
summary: Financial report row and column definitions now include preview capability. Users can set a counterpart definition on each report definition and quickly preview how the row or column layout renders.
key_points: Added per-definition fields to store the preview counterpart (Column Definition on Account Schedule, Row Definition on Column Layout)
Preview action opens a temporary, view-only financial report using the current definition paired with the preview counterpart
Error messaging guides users to set the required preview counterpart field when attempting preview without one
Expanded automated tests verify preview functionality across row and column definitions
No company-wide defaults added to General Ledger Setup per architectural consistency
quote: Set the Column Definition (for Preview) field, then choose Preview.
